request.query: Which drugs frequently co-occur in combination studies for non-small cell lung cancer?

visualization.title: Drug co-occurrence network for non-small cell lung cancer
visualization.subtitle: 4153 trials analyzed; start 2018 to present. Source: ClinicalTrials.gov

interpretation.rationale: A drug co-occurrence network shows which drugs appear together in the same trials, revealing common combination therapy patterns for non-small cell lung cancer since 2018.

[68Ga]Ga-DWJ155: [18F]AlF-NOTA-PCP2 PET/CT Imaging for PD-L1 Expression in Malignant Tumors
Albumin-Bound Paclitaxel: paclitaxel protein-bound particles for injectable suspension
Radiosurgery: Stereotactic Radiosurgery (SRS) or Fractionated Stereotactic Radiotherapy (FSRT)
Stereotactic Radiotherapy(SRT) or Stereotactic Radiosurgery(SRS) or Whole-Brain Radiotherapy(WBRT)
Ramucirumab: Anti-VEGFR-2 Fully Human Monoclonal Antibody IMC-1121B

assumptions: Edge weight = number of trials that list both entities; node size = trials listing the entity.
Placebo, saline and standard-of-care arms are excluded from drug nodes.
Name variants were merged into 746 canonical entities using the records' own otherNames and MeSH terms (see statistics.entity_merges); citations quote the original spelling.
